purpose: Teach: 原型/員数/及ぶ/お上/摘発/人並み/語り口/長らく

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、製品の、絶対、原型、絶対、確認しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need you to verify the product prototype thoroughly. This is serious—I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Clipped, commanding tone with weight behind each phrase. Leans forward slightly. Direct eye contact. Measured pace with intentional pauses between clauses for emphasis.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、社員、絶対、員数、絶対、確認、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We've verified the staff numbers. Thank you for trusting us with this.
lines.style: Respectful and precise. Steady delivery without rushing. Clear acknowledgment of each point. Slight nod of confirmation. Calm competence underlying every word.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 影響、本気で、絶対、各部署に、絶対、及ぶ、絶対、可能性ある、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: There's a real possibility this could affect every department. I need you to understand that.
lines.style: Serious weight on the opening. Slower pace to let the scale sink in. Slight tension in the jaw. Not threatening—factual and grave.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本気で、絶対、お上、絶対、の、絶対、規制、絶対、注視しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're keeping a close eye on regulatory requirements.
lines.style: Calm assurance without overconfidence. Steady rhythm. Shows he's been listening and taking notes. Professional, measured tone throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 不正、本気で、絶対、摘発、絶対、徹底しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I want fraud prevention handled exhaustively. No corners cut.
lines.style: Firm, uncompromising tone. Each word distinct and intentional. Slight edge underneath—not anger, but absolute clarity of expectation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、本気で、絶対、人並み、絶対、以上の、絶対、努力、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our team is putting in effort beyond what's standard. Thank you for your confidence.
lines.style: Humble but confident. Quiet pride in the team's work. Measured delivery. Shows genuine appreciation without flattery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: プレゼン、本気で、絶対、語り口、絶対、ご丁寧にしろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: When we present, I want the narrative handled with care and precision. Make it clear.
lines.style: Deliberate and exacting. Slight lean back—visualizing the presentation. Each instruction lands firmly. Professional but not cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本気で、絶対、長らく、絶対、お取引、絶対、いただきありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're grateful for your continued partnership and trust. We won't let you down.
lines.style: Closing statement with quiet sincerity. Slower pace. Genuine tone without excess emotion. A promise delivered, not performed.
